body:
No effect
After having used ginseng for a few weeks with no noticeable effect, I took the remaining caps (12) to see if a larger dose might have some effect. Nothing. Absolutely nothing. I guess its still possible that huge doses over a period of time might do something, but considering the price ginseng is sold for over here (Europe), that would be extremely expensive.
